SAMJournalApiErrorBody.description:
The ``error`` of a journaled error response: the same shape for every error of the cli and the other journaled apis.

The field names are the values of :class:`smarter.lib.journal.enum.SmarterJournalApiResponseErrorKeys`.

args.description: The exception's arguments, or the request's url.

cause.description: The exception's cause, e.g. 'ValueError: ...', or 'Python Exception'.
cause.title: Cause

context.description: The exception's context, or the response's thing and command.
context.title: Context

description.description: A human-readable description of the error.
description.title: Description

errorClass.description: The name of the exception's class, e.g. SAMBrokerErrorNotFound.
errorClass.title: Errorclass

stacktrace.description: The stack trace. Left out of the responses that a browser may receive.
stacktrace.title: Stacktrace

SAMJournalApiErrorBody.title: SAMJournalApiErrorBody

SAMJournalApiErrorResponse.description:
The body of a journaled error response.

:class:`SAMJournalApiEnvelope`'s ``api`` and ``metadata`` are added beside ``error``.
SAMJournalApiErrorResponse.title: SAMJournalApiErrorResponse

SAMJournalApiMetadata.description:
The ``metadata`` of a journaled response: its command and thing, and, when the journal is enabled, the key of its journal entry.

``command`` and ``thing`` are the strings of the values that the view passed, which may be
``"None"`` when it passed none, so they are not limited to the journal's choices.

key.description: The key of the response's journal entry. Absent while the journal is disabled, or if the entry could not be saved.
key.title: Key

SAMJournalApiMetadata.title: SAMJournalApiMetadata

SAMJournalApiOrmModel.description:
A journal entry: a :class:`smarter.lib.journal.models.SAMJournal` row.

Its fields are exactly the row's fields, so extra fields are forbidden. It is built from the row by
:meth:`from_model`.

user.description: SAMJournal.user: the user's id, or null for an anonymous request.
user.title: User
